notes.title: Update: The First Tournament Version 6
notes.notes:
Welcome to the final update to The First Tournament of Missy's Transformation Tournament! This one features several things, but chiefest among them is the archived fates viewer, allowing you to see all the pawns that fell across all of your stored past games. In addition there is a new type of transformation - Erinacine, which constitutes Hedgehogs, Porcupines and Echidnas as new species - the first of many new species that I hope to add in the future.

Changelog:


 Added the archived fates viewer, allowing for the viewing of the entire backlog of characters stored from your previous games. These are the characters that will be imported when Kingdom mode comes, along with the ability to vet which ones are imported when Kingdom comes. For now, you can simply view them, both pre and after tournament, but all their data is ready to go!
 Added item drops for fallen contestants - contestants will now drop some of their inventory upon defeat, to the ground. This happens both when you defeat a contestant and when contestants defeat one another, so expect more items than normal, both rare and common. As the game progresses, you can expect the quality/rarity of these drops to be greater, as pawns collect more and more stuff.
 Added the Erinacine DNA type and the new Hedgehog, Porcupine and Echidna species into the various aspects of the game. Featuring spines on their head, these species can do a lot of damage! (As a note, this is the first DNA type that is not based on a real one - these species are very separate biologically in life).
 Added the Spinefruit item into the game, fitting into the trend of uncommon items that cause transformations.
 Added the new species transformations to the various transformatives methods that already exist, such as New-U and Missy's events.
 Added new moves for the new species and parts, with one, Echidning, being the first move that can transform into another move.
 Added various new encyclopedia pages for the newly introduced species and item.
 Fixed a bug wherein the Elephant species wouldn't update properly when transforming.
 Fixed the misnamed Andrabsinthe page in the encyclopedia.
 Fixed several small bug fixes to some transformation mechanics.


Alas, The First Tournament is almost over. It will continue only until the next begins in July.

Work on the features exclusive to The Second Tournament is now the priority, featuring feral and tauric forms, new arenas with an arena select screen and many new ways to transform and be transformed. Alongside this will be many changes - Missy will look different, unseen characters will take to the stage and the first story content will rise.

It's wild and it's only going to get wilder from here on out!

The First Tournament was experimental, with feedback allowing it to be more fun, more exciting and more stable than it ever could be.

The First Tournament was about establishing the gameplay, the world and the mechanics. From now on, each Tournament will be themed, with related additions bundled and worked on together, much like how expansions are made for games.

Therefore, there will be no gameplay-adding updates until The Second Tournament launches, sometime in July.

The Second Tournament will be about the wild. The wilderness of the arenas, the pure animal forms of feral pawns and biological traits of transformed bodies. That's the focus for The Second Tournament, but of course, that's not all that's being worked on.

Stay tuned for more details as they solidify.

Until next time!

- Jake

notes.title: Update: The First Tournament Version 5
notes.notes:
Welcome to the next gameplay-adding update to Missy's Transformation Tournament! This one features a really big feature that has been in the works for a while: an in-game encyclopedia, among other things, including tutorials and several data-based changes.

Changelog:


 Added an in-game encyclopedia, accessible on the menu in-game and on the main menu outside of a tournament. Pages have to be unlocked - by turning into a species or clicking on a NPC to unlock the associated species page, by having an item in your inventory for item pages and through various data points in a tournament for everything else.
 Added over 150 pages in the encyclopedia across 7 categories.
 Added a index for the encyclopedia, to sort through the many pages across the categories.
 Added twelve in-game tutorial screens to appear at various points of a player's tournament mode career.
 Added the ability to view all tutorials outside of a game on the main menu, outside of a tournament.
 Made the tutorial button in the options work with the new tutorial system - turn it off and on to toggle tutorials in-game.
 Added the ability to view unlocked pages of the encyclopedia outside of a game on the main menu.
 Added a info button on the main menu for accessing the encyclopedia and tutorials.
 Added a script to unlock pages for currently inaccessible species.
 Added data points as a new object in tournament mode. Click on them to have a chance to unlock a new encyclopedia page. Around 20 will spawn per tournament.
 Added minutes points, similar to data points, but specific to unlocking Missy's Minutes pages. Around 4 will spawn her tournament.
 The game will now store tutorial and encyclopedia page data in the game's save folder, persistent across all games.
 Added under-the-hood support for more characters in the game's data, as well as future clothing options for the upcoming Missy's Kingdom mode.
 Made homonine tails to be invisible, like a human's


More pages will come in future updates, as well as additions to the currently existing pages, especially the Places and Lore categories.

Next, I plan to work on the archived fates viewer and various little additions. The next version, Version 6, will be the last version of The First Tournament to be released.

After that, well... you best prepare for The Second Tournament.

Because things are going to get wild!

Until next time!

- Jake

notes.title: Update: The First Tournament Version 4
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first gameplay-adding update to Missy's Transformation Tournament! This one has a lot of things, but the principal feature is skin types - an entire new body part to transform!

Changelog:


 Add skin types into the game. Currently, these are bare skin, fur, scales, feathers and wool, with support for more in the future.
 Added the ability to delete champions.
 Expanded the scope of the sex system - now, the symbol on your character screen will change depending on your body configuration.
 Two new sexes have been added - intersex (for those that are not strictly male or female) and null (no sex). These can happen during a game's transformations.
 Made the transformations of pawns unto other pawns more powerful, so you'll see more pure morphs during the course of a game.
 Added a new item: the Skinchanger, into the game. Skinchangers can be found in common chests and change only your skin type.
 Added humanity losses to traps and effect zones.
 Added a cheat notification for the Velvet Deluxe Pass' cheat screen. This will let you know if your game is eligible for leaderboards. Using cheats or passwords will trigger your game to be 'cheated'.
 Added a limit to the archived fates - for the moment, the limit is 50,000.
 Added two new passwords to the Velvet Deluxe Pass' passwords system - MISSYSUCKS will trigger an event whilst FORECASTER will change the weather.
 Added a skin type selector into the Velvet Deluxe Pass' enhanced character creator.
 Changed the turtle torso by taking the shell and making it the first in a new kind of body part - back placeables. This also fixes some of the overlap it had previously.
 Updated all transformations to include skin types.
 Removed wool from the sheep torso sprite and converted its sprite into the new skin type mechanic.
 Fixed a bug where trunks of elephant-morphs appeared under male pawn's beards.
 Fixed the diet text in the character screen - it will now be accurate to your form.
 Added some more subheaders for the title screen.


A quick note: the sprites for the skin types will likely be tweaked in the coming days and weeks to better fit all combinations of body types.

Next, I plan to work on the tutorials and the in-game encyclopedia - to make understanding the game and its world a whole lot smoother.

Until next time!

- Jake

notes.title: Missy's Bulletin #2: Post-Release Plans
notes.notes:
Well the release week has come and gone and what a week it was! A lot of feedback has been received and logged - thanks to everyone for your supporting words!

Already Version 3 of The First Tournament as been released, addressing some of the most important issues brought up. However, there are a good deal more that I would like to see done before The Second Tournament comes out.

That is what June's updates will be about.

Here's a list of what you can expect to see added by the end of this month. Bare in mind, some of these may be expanded and/or moved to a later update as development continues:


 Archived fates viewer - so you can view pawns in all your past games
 New sex mechanics - additional in-between sexes will be added so your character will gradually have their sex symbol changed throughout the game
 More powerful transformations - NPC pawns will be able to dish out more powerful transformations as the game progresses
 Tutorials - a comprehensive in-game guide to playing Missy's Transformation Tournament through in-game tips and instructions
 Hedgehogs, Porcupines and Echidnas - a new genus of animal to transform into and transform others into! Featuring prickly spines and pointy attacks!
 Skin types - skin will be able to be transformed from standard bare skin to fur, scales and feathers. Features additional textures and colours based on your hair.
 In-game encyclopedia - the beginnings of an in-game source of lore, glancing into the world of Missy's Transformation Tournament.


These are in addition to the various tweaks and bug fixes that have been logged.

The first new Version will come sometime in the middle of this month and these features will come in waves instead of all at once.

Also, bare in mind that if one or more of these features are particularly troublesome, they may be worked on and/or moved into next month. We'll see, though!

More details will come as the Versions come a-rolling.

Until next time, stay in her good graces!

- Jake

notes.title: Update: The First Tournament Version 3
notes.notes:
Just a quick update to address some balance issues and needed features. There'll more the coming weeks, but these are the most pressing.

Changelog:


 Increased the amount of thirst that water bottles and few other hydrating items restore, so you need to drink less
 Made NPC pawns more aggressive by a factor of two, on average
 Added the ability to cancel a move by right-clicking with the mouse
 Decreased the speed of hunger depletion, so it goes down slower
 Decreased the speed of thirst depletion, so it goes down slower
 Decreased the player's movement speed slightly
 Added humanity losses to most transformative items, so that they decrease your humanity meter slightly with each use
 Fixed some minor errors in Missy's events


The next update will focus on new features - look forward to it in Early June!

See you then!

- Jake
